description: Motor A (12 V, 30:1 gearmotor, 64 CPR encoder) voltage step 3 V -> 9 V, encoder logged at 1 kHz
model: i: L di/dt = V(t - Ts) - R i - kt w_m;  w_m: J dw_m/dt = kt i - b w_m - Tc tanh(w_m/0.5);  theta_out = theta_m / N;  J = Jm + JL/N^2; encoder counts = floor(theta_out cpr/(2 pi))
nonidealities: encoder quantization, 1-sample PWM update delay, 0.5 % PWM amplitude ripple, Coulomb friction (equivalent 0.25 V), electrical lag L/R
